test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What would come in (5)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3** i.e. 'pride'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes how Ravi and Arjun’s rivalry transforms into teamwork and mutual respect.
 
• The blank (5) requires a word that completes the idea of shared feelings or values developed through cooperation.
 
• **"Pride"** fits well, as it conveys the sense of accomplishment and satisfaction they share after overcoming rivalry. (गर्व)
 
• Example: The team felt a deep sense of **pride** after winning the championship together.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pressure** (दबाव): Refers to stress or tension, which does not fit the context of shared achievement.
 
• **Fear** (भय): Refers to anxiety or apprehension, which is unrelated to the positive outcome described.
 
• **Conflict** (संघर्ष): Refers to a clash or disagreement, which is contrary to the resolution and teamwork highlighted.
